notes: Weighting and test-performance correction produce every estimate; the age-sex raking is recorded once as weighting, not as a separate standardization, and depth is not stratified because it only yields population estimates. The rapid test's sensitivity and specificity are cited from unpublished CDC data, so no diagnostic-accuracy procedure is recorded. Comparison framework is group because the first finding sentence is descriptive.
view_issues: The claim that seroprevalence exceeds the 20% threshold in vaccine-eligible ages has no test, and some age-specific CIs include 20% (age 9: 16–71; age 13: 18–89). The 9–13 estimate (51%) has no CI. The district 'higher' and sex 'similar' claims have no test, and the district CIs overlap. Five of the 15 schools were selected directly, not by probability sampling.
